With the onset of the North-East monsoon and the cyclone alert issued by the Regional Meteorological Centre, this Department has activated the network of emergency shelters across the city. In accordance with the Standing Orders for Disaster Response, 2023, all shelters that are opened for public use shall be duly certified by the respective Zonal Officer and the certificate forwarded to this office within 24 hours of occupancy. Similarly, the closure of any shelter shall be certified and communicated within 24 hours of the last occupant leaving the premises.

The following pages contain the consolidated register of shelters opened and closed during the current season, along with the relevant certificates. All entries are serially numbered and bear the date stamp of this office. Any discrepancy in the register shall be reported to the undersigned immediately.

Sd/-
**R. Meenakshi Sundaram**
Deputy Commissioner (Disaster Management)
For Commissioner, Greater Chennai Municipal Corporation

documents.title: City Records - Shelter Openings and Closures
documents.content:
With the onset of the North-East monsoon and the cyclone alert issued by the Regional Meteorological Centre, this Department has activated the network of emergency shelters across the city. In accordance with the Standing Orders for Disaster Response, 2023, all shelters that are opened for public use shall be duly certified by the respective Zonal Officer and the certificate forwarded to this office within 24 hours of occupancy. Similarly, the closure of any shelter shall be certified and communicated within 24 hours of the last occupant leaving the premises.

The following pages contain the consolidated register of shelters opened and closed during the current season, along with the relevant certificates. All entries are serially numbered and bear the date stamp of this office. Any discrepancy in the register shall be reported to the undersigned immediately.

Sd/-
**R. Meenakshi Sundaram**
Deputy Commissioner (Disaster Management)
For Commissioner, Greater Chennai Municipal Corporation

Date: 05-12-2024
Place: Chennai

---

**REGISTER OF SHELTER OPENINGS AND CLOSURES – 2024–25**

**Entry No. 01**
**Name of Shelter:** Corporation Higher Secondary School, Thiruvottiyur
**Ward No.:** 01
**Type of Shelter:** School Building
**Capacity (persons):** 350
**Date of Opening:** 18-11-2024
**Date of Closure:** 22-11-2024
**Remarks:** Opened in anticipation of cyclone ‘Fengal’. Water sanitation facilities were provided by Ward 01. Closed after the building was handed back to the school authorities following disinfection.

**Certificate No.:** GCMC/RDM/2024/OP/001 (Opening), GCMC/RDM/2024/CL/001 (Closure)

---

**Entry No. 02**
**Name of Shelter:** Kaveri Shelter
**Ward No.:** 14 (Teynampet Zone)
**Type of Shelter:** Dedicated shelter (Permanent structure)
**Capacity (persons):** 200
**Date of Opening:** 20-11-2024
**Date of Closure:** Not yet closed (as of 05-12-2024)
**Remarks:** City records state that Kaveri Shelter's opened_date is 2024-11-20. Record status: historical. This shelter is a permanent, dedicated facility and was brought into service on the above date as part of the pre-cyclone preparedness plan. It is currently operational and housing 47 families (approx. 160 persons) from low-lying areas of Ward 14. The shelter is being managed by the Teynampet Zonal Office with support from the Tamil Nadu State Disaster Management Authority (TNSDMA). A separate closure certificate will be issued upon the shelter being decommissioned for the season.

**Certificate No.:** GCMC/RDM/2024/OP/003 (Opening)

---

**Entry No. 03**
**Name of Shelter:** Community Hall, Velachery
**Ward No.:** 174
**Type of Shelter:** Community Hall
**Capacity (persons):** 120
**Date of Opening:** 19-11-2024
**Date of Closure:** 25-11-2024
**Remarks:** Opened for residents of the Velachery marshland periphery. The hall was used as a temporary shelter for 3 days beyond the initial closure date due to waterlogging on the access road. Final closure certified on 25-11-2024 after the premises were cleaned and keys returned to the Velachery Residents’ Welfare Association.

**Certificate No.:** GCMC/RDM/2024/OP/002 (Opening), GCMC/RDM/2024/CL/002 (Closure)

---

**Entry No. 04**
**Name of Shelter:** Corporation Primary School, Saidapet
**Ward No.:** 130
**Type of Shelter:** School Building
**Capacity (persons):** 250
**Date of Opening:** 21-11-2024
**Date of Closure:** 26-11-2024
**Remarks:** Shelter served the Saidapet bus-stand area and nearby tenements. Medical camp held on 23-11-2024 by the Urban Primary Health Centre, Saidapet. Closure certified after all evacuees returned to their homes and the building was handed over to the school headmaster.

**Certificate No.:** GCMC/RDM/2024/OP/004 (Opening), GCMC/RDM/2024/CL/003 (Closure)

---

**Entry No. 05**
**Name of Shelter:** Marriage Hall, Kolathur (Private, requisitioned)
**Ward No.:** 82
**Type of Shelter:** Private hall (requisitioned under Section 30 of the Disaster Management Act, 2005)
**Capacity (persons):** 300
**Date of Opening:** 22-11-2024
**Date of Closure:** 27-11-2024
**Remarks:** Requisitioned for use as an overflow shelter for Kolathur and Padi. The owner was compensated at the rate of INR 5,000 per day for the period of requisition. The hall was restored to the owner on 27-11-2024.

**Ward No.:** 12
**Type of Shelter:** School Building
**Capacity (persons):** 400
**Date of Opening:** 24-11-2024
**Date of Closure:** 30-11-2024
**Remarks:** Opened for residents of low-lying areas in Tondiarpet and the fishing hamlet along the
north Chennai coast. The school was selected as a primary shelter given its elevated location and
access to the main road. Evacuees were housed in the ground-floor classrooms; the first floor was
kept for storage of relief materials. A total of 217 persons registered on the first night. The
shelter was closed on 30-11-2024 after the area was declared safe by the Zonal Health Officer.
The building was cleaned by Corporation conservancy staff and handed over to the Headmaster on
01-12-2024. A damage inspection of the toilet block was carried out and a report forwarded to the
Works Department on 02-12-2024.

**Certificate No.:** GCMC/RDM/2024/OP/005 (Opening), GCMC/RDM/2024/CL/004 (Closure)

**Entry No. 07**
**Name of Shelter:** Sri Ramalinga Nadar Marriage Hall, Perambur
**Ward No.:** 48
**Type of Shelter:** Private Marriage Hall (requisitioned)
**Capacity (persons):** 200
**Date of Opening:** 25-11-2024
**Date of Closure:** 29-11-2024
**Remarks:** Requisitioned under Section 30 of the Disaster Management Act, 2005, for use as a
shelter for residents of the Perambur railway quarters and the Erukkanchery canal basin. The hall
was equipped with 150 cots and a temporary kitchen. The owner was compensated at the rate of
INR 4,000 per day for the period of requisition. The hall was vacated on 29-11-2024 and restored
to the owner on the same day. One complaint regarding a broken ceiling fan was received from the
owner; the fan was replaced and the complaint was closed on 02-12-2024.

**Certificate No.:** GCMC/RDM/2024/OP/006 (Opening), GCMC/RDM/2024/CL/005 (Closure)

undergoing minor repairs to its roof following the earlier rains. Repairs were completed on
26-11-2024 and the hall was inspected by the Assistant Engineer (Buildings) before being declared
fit for occupation. The shelter served residents of Manali and the adjoining industrial belt.
The hall remained open until 05-12-2024 because the access road to the Manali bus route remained
flooded until that date. Closure was certified after the road was cleared and all evacuees had
returned. Keys were handed over to the Manali Town Panchayat office on 06-12-2024.

**Certificate No.:** GCMC/RDM/2024/OP/007 (Opening), GCMC/RDM/2024/CL/006 (Closure)

**Remarks:** Opened for residents of the Madhavaram Milk Colony and the low-lying areas near the
